columns.name: USAGE
columns.description: Indicates the purpose for which the responsibility is used

columns.name: BYPASS_PREVIEW
columns.description: Indicates whether to bypass the preview while autoprovisioning.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: A name which describes this template

columns.name: TEMPLATE_CODE
columns.description: A code which uniquely identifies this template

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The effective start date of the template

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The effective end date of the template

columns.name: REPSONSIBILITY_TYPE
columns.description: The responsibility type which would be used for creating areas of responsibility data

columns.name: SYNC_ENABLED
columns.description: Indicates whether to allow synchronization for this template

columns.name: WORK_CONTACTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to include this row in work contacts evaluation

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Indicates whether this template is active or not.

columns.name: STATUS_INDICATOR
columns.description: This flag indicates template's current status with respect to auto provision.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
